filing_fee_notes: Biennial reporting is separate: 30 online or 45 on paper.
registered_agent_rules: Designate an agent and registered-office street address. An individual owner or employee serving as agent must reside in Iowa, be at least 18 and have an Iowa office.
annual_report_due: January 1 through April 1 of odd-numbered years.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization and designate an Iowa registered agent. File biennial reports in odd-numbered years.
common_mistake: Following the even-year reporting schedule used for profit corporations.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Report fee field records online filing. UI URL is the official 2026 employer handbook directing registration through myIowaUI. Direct name-search URL, standard processing time, expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
